subject: Intro: Coordinating VP/CTO attendance and compact demo window
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@orchidtech.com>

Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@orchidtech.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood intro + demo — aligning exec availability

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the intro earlier this week through Ben — we’re excited to see Redwood in action. Our CTO (Celine Park) and VP Product (Priya) want an exec-level walkthrough before we get into technical depth. They prefer a compact window that highlights ROI, reliability, and a short Q&A.

Celine’s calendar is tight next week; right now she has two possible windows (PT):
- Tue 2026-08-11, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed 2026-08-12, 3:00–3:45 PM PT

If you can accommodate a 30–45 minute slot where an exec-focused 20-minute walkthrough is front-loaded, that would be ideal. We also have a short procurement checklist we’d like to surface during the call. Attaching a one-pager to this mail so your team can prep.

Attachments: Orchid_ask-onepager.pdf (attachment)

Best,
Alex
Alex Ramos

alex.ramos@orchidtech.com

- 20 min: VP/CTO-focused overview (value props, SLA/cost guardrails, dedicated/private options)
- 25 min: technical deep-dive / ops Q&A (engine & runbook)

Given Celine’s brief window, we can compress the exec portion into 20 minutes and start with the exec walkthrough. Two concrete slots that work for our team (PT):
- Tue 2026-08-11, 11:10–11:50 AM PT (starts 10 minutes in to give buffer)
- Wed 2026-08-12, 2:50–3:30 PM PT

I’ve attached our demo runbook and a trimmed executive deck so you can see what will be covered in the 20-min section. Can you confirm which slot Celine prefers and whether Priya will join the exec segment or the full session? Also, do you want us to invite a technical SE for the deep-dive?

Attachments: Demo-Runbook-v2.docx, Redwood-exec-trimmed.pdf (both attachments)

Cheers,

Forwarding the one-pager again for visibility.
